name: Providence County, RI
findings: Providence County has 2,440 nonprofit organizations. 852 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 719 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Providence County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
